standard.summary: 训练前段用较低分辨率，后段切到较高分辨率。
standard.effect: 前期更快学习整体构图，后期把容量留给局部细节。
standard.whenToUse: 素材细节多、显存有限、希望先稳住整体再补细节时适合。
standard.avoidWhen: 已经使用固定 latent cache 且没有为各阶段生成缓存时，不要只改 resolution。

standard_en.summary: Trains at a lower resolution early and switches to a higher one later.
standard_en.effect: The early stage learns overall composition faster, and the later stage spends capacity on local detail.
standard_en.whenToUse: Suits detailed material, limited VRAM, and any case where you want the whole settled before filling in detail.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When a fixed latent cache is already in use and no cache has been generated for each stage, do not change resolution alone.

advanced.principle: 分辨率改变会改变 latent 形状和 bucket 分布。cache-first 路线必须在缓存生成阶段准备对应分辨率。
advanced.intervention: 介入 dataset bucket、latent cache 和训练阶段切换；高分辨率阶段 batch 通常需要用户单独控制。
advanced.expectedImpact: 低分阶段可降低早期成本，高分阶段提升纹理和小物件学习机会。
advanced.tradeoffs: 阶段比例不当会导致后期细节学习步数不足；缓存、bucket、batch、学习率都需要配套。

advanced_en.principle: Changing resolution changes latent shapes and bucket distribution. Cache-first routes must prepare the corresponding resolutions at cache-generation time.
advanced_en.intervention: Intervenes in dataset bucketing, latent cache, and training-stage switching; the high-resolution stage's batch usually needs separate user control.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Low-resolution stages cut early costs; high-resolution stages improve texture and small-object learning opportunities.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Poorly proportioned stages leave too few steps for late detail learning; cache, buckets, batch, and learning rate all need coordinated adjustment.
